usage: 凍綠茶 is used as a noun to refer to a cold drink made from green tea served with ice.
You can use 凍綠茶 to order drinks in a restaurant or café.
It can be combined with quantity words like 杯 (cup) to specify the amount, e.g. 一杯凍綠茶.
凍綠茶 can also be contrasted with 熱綠茶 (hot green tea) when ordering.
In conversation, 凍綠茶 can be shortened to just '凍茶' if the type of tea is clear.
